reset_sent: If the account exists, a reset link has been generated.
no_incidents: No relevant incidents in the last 24 hours.
no_results: No results with the current filters.
onboarding_hint: Choose the countries you follow and your language. You can change this anytime in “My account”.
to_confirm_note: Single-source, extreme-severity event — awaiting corroboration. Do not distribute as an alert.
login_invite_hint: Access is by invitation only. If you don't have an account yet, request an invitation from your delegation's administrator.
invite_welcome: You have been invited. Set your password to create your account.
admin_invite_hint: Enter the new user's email: a single-use link (valid for 72 h) will be generated for you to send them. They will use it to set their password and, on first login, their countries and language.
admin_collect_started: Daily collection started in the background. It may take 30–60 min; reload this page to follow progress under "Runs".
admin_collect_running: A collection is already running — wait for it to finish.
admin_collect_hint: The daily collection runs automatically via cron. This button triggers it manually (initial fill or testing).
admin_collect_cancelling: Cancellation requested — collection will stop within a few seconds, keeping what was already stored.
coverage_hint: These sources' direct feeds did not respond during the last collection. Their content may still arrive via Google News, but direct coverage is degraded.
admin_probe_hint: For failing sources, “Diagnose” reads their home page and reports what it contains — writing nothing to the database.
admin_probing: Diagnosis running in the background: reload the page in a couple of minutes to see the results.
admin_sweep_hint: “Review the panel” re-applies the filters to already published events: retires those outside the perimeter, reattributes them to the right country and fills in map coordinates. No collection — takes seconds.
